request: 做的时候一定要更人性化，不要让人不知道怎么用，你可以做完了之后全面排查aide和对应所有插件的类似问题
acceptance: Inventory all current public market packages, private listings and corresponding independent local plugin IDs; pin package hashes/source revisions and separate visible/runtime/source-only evidence.

Actually inspect Aide core journeys and every applicable plugin entry/first-use or unavailable state, including desktop/narrow UI and contextual guidance; tool-only/adapters/presets must explain their use honestly.

Confirm and fix discoverability, configuration, save/recovery, draft, keyboard or misleading-state defects with focused meaningful regressions; preserve existing layout, user data, licensing/signatures and permission boundaries.
Provide readable help and next actions without forcing technical identifiers into primary user flows; keep private specifics out of public issues/docs.
Run relevant browser/API/race checks and complete the applicable full gates/CI for owned source changes, update usage docs and a per-plugin audit matrix with actual limits.
scope: Owned host worktree based on 6878e5f8 and isolated plugin worktrees when confirmed source fixes are required; never overwrite the original local plugin work.
Synthetic data/disposable services; no production restart, live paid-provider/account calls, private artifact publication, signature/permission bypass or unsolicited UI redesign.

requirements.summary: User explicitly requested human-oriented UX and a comprehensive corresponding-plugin audit after the remaining core improvements.

Confirmed bugs tracked in #883–886.

Frozen rerun with expanded inventory and full remain pending.
